1: // Pixel Dodger – simple canvas game
2: // Canvas with id="game"
3: (() => {
4:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
5:   if (!canvas) return;
6:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
7:   const width = canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth || 400;
8:   const height = canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight || 600;
9: 
10:   // Player
11:   const player = { w: 40, h: 20, x: width / 2 - 20, y: height - 30, speed: 5 };
12: 
13:   // Blocks
14:   const blocks = [];
15:   let blockSpawnTimer = 0;
16:   let blockSpawnInterval = 1500; // ms
17:   let blockSpeed = 2;
18:   let lastTime = 0;
19:   let score = 0;
20:   let gameOver = false;
21: 
22:   // Input
23:   const keys = {};
24:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => (keys[e.key] = true));
25:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => (keys[e.key] = false));
26: 
27:   function spawnBlock() {
28:     const size = Math.random() * 30 + 20;
29:     const x = Math.random() * (width - size);
30:     blocks.push({ x, y: -size, w: size, h: size });
31:   }
32: 
33:   function update(dt) {
34:     // player movement
35:     if (keys['ArrowLeft'] || keys['a']) player.x -= player.speed;
36:     if (keys['ArrowRight'] || keys['d']) player.x += player.speed;
37:     player.x = Math.max(0, Math.min(width - player.w, player.x));
38: 
39:     // spawn blocks
40:     blockSpawnTimer += dt;
41:     if (blockSpawnTimer > blockSpawnInterval) {
42:       spawnBlock();
43:       blockSpawnTimer = 0;
44:     }
45: 
46:     // update blocks
47:     for (let i = blocks.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
48:       const b = blocks[i];
49:       b.y += blockSpeed * (dt / 16.67);
50:       // collision
51:       if (
52:         b.x < player.x + player.w &&
53:         b.x + b.w > player.x &&
54:         b.y < player.y + player.h &&
55:         b.y + b.h > player.y
56:       ) {
57:         gameOver = true;
58:       }
59:       // remove off‑screen
60:       if (b.y > height) blocks.splice(i, 1);
61:     }
62: 
63:     // increase difficulty over time
64:     blockSpeed += dt * 0.00001; // gradual acceleration
65:     blockSpawnInterval = Math.max(300, blockSpawnInterval - dt * 0.01);
66:     score = Math.floor((performance.now() - startTime) / 1000);
67:   }
68: 
69:   function draw() {
70:     ctx.clearRect(0, 0, width, height);
71:     // player
72:     ctx.fillStyle = '#0f0';
73:     ctx.fillRect(player.x, player.y, player.w, player.h);
74:     // blocks
75:     ctx.fillStyle = '#f00';
76:     blocks.forEach(b => ctx.fillRect(b.x, b.y, b.w, b.h));
77:     // score
78:     ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
79:     ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
80:     ctx.fillText('Score: ' + score, 10, 20);
81:     if (gameOver) {
82:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)';
83:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
84:       ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
85:       ctx.font = '30px sans-serif';
86:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', width / 2 - 80, height / 2);
87:     }
88:   }
89: 
90:   function loop(timestamp) {
91:     if (!lastTime) lastTime = timestamp;
92:     const dt = timestamp - lastTime;
93:     lastTime = timestamp;
94:     if (!gameOver) update(dt);
95:     draw();
96:     if (!gameOver) requestAnimationFrame(loop);
97:   }
98: 
99:   const startTime = performance.now();
100:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
101: })();
